`component-contract-3.7.12.json` records public component attributes and observed
SelectorQuery defaults/bound values from the read-only conformance suite's 3.7.12
simulator baseline. `null` means the query field was absent after JSON
normalization; it does not assert that the visual feature is unsupported.

The runtime schema is metadata for real attribute reads and conversions. Tests
keep independent expected values and exercise compiled templates and public
SelectorQuery calls in Chrome. No reference implementation code is included.
